args.sql:
WITH MaintenanceDelays AS (
    SELECT 
        regmaintregistry AS EquipmentID,
        compscore AS ComplianceScore,
        maintdatenext - maintdatelast AS Delay,
        CASE WHEN maintdatenext < CURRENT_DATE THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS IsOverdue
    FROM 
        "RegulatoryAndMaintenance"
    WHERE 
        compscore IS NOT NULL
),
RankedDelays AS (
    SELECT 
        EquipmentID,
        ComplianceScore,
        Delay,
        IsOverdue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY Delay DESC) AS DelayRank
    FROM 
        MaintenanceDelays
)
SELECT 
    EquipmentID,
    ComplianceScore,
    Delay,
    IsOverdue
FROM 
    RankedDelays
WHERE 
    DelayRank <= 5
ORDER BY 
    Delay DESC;
